name: Demo — Operation Dream Job
description: Demo scenario inspired by publicly documented Operation Dream Job activity. It expands selected behaviors across logical layers to create a rich ATT&CK visualization and is not an authoritative incident reconstruction.

layers.name: EXT-INFRA
layers.description: External adversary infrastructure layer for researching recruiting targets and preparing personas, domains, hosted content, servers, and malware.

layers.name: DMZ-MAIL
layers.description: Mail and messaging boundary where job-themed messages, malicious files, links, and trusted online delivery channels reach the target.

layers.name: INT-ENDPOINT
layers.description: Internal user endpoint layer where delivered content is opened, staged payloads execute, persistence is established, and the host is profiled.

techniques.comment: Opening the delivered file is marked seen in the endpoint analysis.

layers.name: INT-NETWORK
layers.description: Internal network layer for enumerating domain resources, locating valuable files, archiving collections, and returning data.

techniques.comment: The expected exfiltration path has not yet been corroborated in the demo evidence set.
